summary: Iteration 215 frontend-only verification. All 3 new feature user stories PASS in the live preview at https://gojek-clone-41.preview.emergentagent.com. (1) Bidding 'Tarif moyen accepté' hint renders only for vehicles present in GET /api/rides/bidding/avg-fares (SB: 21,46 €), localized via money(). (2) Merchant 'Partager ma boutique' card shows QR canvas (180x180), public link <origin>/food/<merchantId>, copy/download/print buttons all functional with no JS errors. (3) Storefront ShareStoreSheet opens with WhatsApp/SMS/Copier le lien, copy triggers 'Lien copié !' toast and closes the sheet.
critical_code_review_comments: RideChoosePage.js L106/L316: avgFares state + rideAPI.biddingAvgFares() fetch on mount when isBidding — correct gating. L636-639: green emerald hint with Gavel icon + money(avgFares[v.slug]) renders ONLY when isBidding AND avgFares[v.slug] != null. Verified live: only [data-testid=avg-fare-sb] is rendered (backend returns just sb≈21.46), other vehicle cards correctly omit the line. Localized to '21,46 €' via French locale — matches spec.

MerchantShareCard.jsx: Uses qrcode.react QRCodeCanvas (180px) wrapped in a Card with data-testid='merchant-share-card'. Public URL is built from window.location.origin + '/food/' + merchantId — verified value '<preview-origin>/food/merchant_d3cc002c7d87' matches /api spec. downloadQR converts canvas → toBlob → anchor click (filename 'QR-<storeName>.png' — captured 'QR-Resto-Demo-SB.png'). printQR opens window.print after a small wait — verified by stubbing window.print and observing it was invoked. No JS errors on any of the three button clicks.

ShareStoreSheet.jsx: Bottom sheet with z-[130] overlay (data-testid='share-store-sheet'). WhatsApp link uses wa.me?text=, SMS uses sms:?&body=, share-copy uses navigator.clipboard.writeText + toast.success('Lien copié !') + onClose(). All three testids verified present. Copy path verified end-to-end: toast appears, sheet unmounts.

Minor (non-blocking): MerchantShareCard reads window.location.origin at render-time; if a user opens the merchant settings on a domain different from the public app domain (e.g. an admin subdomain), the QR/link will point to the same origin. Not an issue for the current single-origin setup but worth a comment.

Minor (non-blocking): ShareStoreSheet does not surface the native Web Share API option in the rendered sheet for desktop testing — the spec mentions 'natif' but the visible options are WhatsApp/SMS/Copier le lien only. On mobile UA where navigator.share exists, an additional native button would be nice; not required by the spec data-testids.
